caption: The drawing depicts an object that has a flat, ornate, brass-colored metal head with a pierced design that includes symmetrical scrollwork and a central motif resembling a stylized animal or bird flanked by foliage. The metal head is attached to a turned, brown wooden handle. At the top of the metal head, there are three large, rounded cut-out sections, and its outer frame is slightly curved. The metal portion displays some shaded areas, suggesting depth, and includes small cut-outs and engraved details. In the bottom left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simplified, yellow outline of the metal head viewed from the front, adjacent to a scale labeled “inches.” The drawing is signed “BENJAMIN RESNICK” in capital letters at the bottom right. The entire composition is framed within a penciled rectangular border, and the background is a plain off-white color with some areas of yellowed aging visible around the edges.
title: Trivet
